Organisation44/OrganisationIdentificatio: In case of conflict between the Organization Identification and the Full Legal Name, it is recommended that the account servicer ask for clarification by means of an AdditionalInformationRequest message.
PaymentInstruction49/ChequeAndCreditorAc: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount is not allowed.
PaymentInstruction49/ChequeDeliveryAndCr: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is present and is equal to MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent) or PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent must be present.
PaymentInstruction49/ChequeDeliveryAndNo: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod/Code is present and different from MLFA (MailToFinalAgent), CRFA (CourierToFinalAgent), RGFA (RegisteredMailToFinalAgent) or PUFA (PickUpByFinalAgent), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent is not allowed.
PaymentInstruction49/ChequeInstructionRu: If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Check), then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction is not allowed.
PaymentInstruction49/ChequeNoDeliveryAnd: If PaymentMethod is CHK (Check) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction/DeliveryMethod is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAgent is not allowed.
PaymentInstruction49/NonChequePaymentMet: If PaymentMethod is different from CHK (Check) and CreditTransferTransactionInformation/Creditor is not present, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/CreditorAccount must be present.
